steps.text: In the Plains of Havoc, just west of the cyclops, orc and minotaur camp: the dead body half hidden by a tree has an iron helmet (leather armors, letters and worn boots lie around it).
steps.source: There is simply a dead body partially obscured by a tree in the Plains of Havoc, just west of the Cyclops / Orc / Minotaur camp (Mapper Coords 128.19, 125.232, 7).
